claims.text: Unordered text documents exist and are processed in applications like summarization and question answering.
The process of structuring unordered documents is essential for improving coherence and flow in text processing.
Experiments have been conducted on unordered documents, demonstrating their presence in real-world corpora such as Wikipedia.
